// Process Gravity Knowledge Base
// Full text content split into chunks for Pinecone ingestion

const knowledgeBase = `
SECTION 1 - COMPANY OVERVIEW
Process Gravity is an AI automation consulting firm that helps service-based small and medium-sized business owners reclaim their time and grow their businesses using custom-built AI systems. We are not a software company. We are not a generic AI tool. We are a done-for-you implementation partner that builds AI automation custom to each client specific craft, business, and customer base and stays as their ongoing AI partner as the technology evolves.

Founding Team: Chad is the client-facing lead and business development, handling prospect outreach, audit conversations, client relationships, and sales. Deepak is the operations lead handling process discipline, CRM, automation builds, and delivery management. Jill handles quality, compliance and data governance including NDAs, proposal templates, cybersecurity, and policy. Sri is the senior technical advisor handling IT architecture, technical reviews, knowledge base structure, and tool stack. The team has approximately 80 years of combined enterprise software experience.

Contact: Website is processgravity.vercel.app. Email is hello@processgravity.com. Location is Calgary, Alberta, Canada.

Core Mission: We give service business owners their evenings and weekends back. Then we help them build the business they always believed was possible.

Brand Promises: Done for you. Not done to you. Input once. Run forever. Dashboard daily. We build the engine. You drive the business. No pitch. No contract. Just a conversation.

SECTION 2 - IDEAL CUSTOMER PROFILE
Our primary persona is Sam and Sarah. They are a husband-wife team or solopreneur in the service industry including trades, health and wellness, salon, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, and landscaping. Their annual revenue is between 500000 and 10000000 dollars. Their team size is 1 to 5 people with no full-time admin staff. They work from 5:30AM to 5PM on the tools and then spend evenings and weekends on admin. They are profitable enough to pay for a solution but too stretched to find one. Their tech comfort is moderate - they use email, WhatsApp, and basic booking software but are not tech enthusiasts.

What Sam and Sarah are thinking: This never ends. We work harder every year and the pile does not shrink. We could grow but we are too buried to even look up.

What Sam and Sarah are feeling: Overwhelmed. Anxious. Guilty about missing family time. Early burnout. A quiet fear that this is just life now.

What Sam and Sarah have already tried: Family, friends, summer students. Cheap but unreliable. High turnover, inconsistent quality. Always back to square one.

What Sam and Sarah have not found: Something that works quietly in the background. Handles the repetitive tasks. Does not need training. Just works.

Early Adopter Profile: Burned out but still ambitious. AI-curious not AI-hostile. Referred by someone they trust. Willing to share results as a testimonial if we over-deliver.

Who we are NOT for: Large companies with existing IT departments. Startups with no revenue yet. Businesses looking for a one-time project with no ongoing relationship. Anyone looking for generic AI tools they can use themselves.

SECTION 3 - THE PROBLEM WE SOLVE
Service-based SMB owners and solopreneurs are trapped in an endless cycle of low-value high-volume operational tasks that consume their time, cap their growth, erode their quality of life, and keep them permanently stuck at the same level. Not because they lack ambition but because they lack the systems, technology, and outside perspective to break the cycle.

Top problems we automate: Lead follow-up and prospect nurturing has very high automation potential. Invoice creation follow-up and collections has very high automation potential. After-hours call handling and appointment booking has very high automation potential using AI Voice. Customer onboarding and FAQ responses has very high automation potential using Chatbots. Social media content creation and scheduling has high automation potential. Manual data entry across systems has very high automation potential. Payroll expense tracking and bookkeeping prep has high automation potential. Scheduling reminders and calendar management has high automation potential. Proposal and quote generation has high automation potential. Reporting and performance dashboards has high automation potential.

A day in the life: At 5:30AM they wake up and check messages from the night before, starting the day already behind. At 6AM they manually review bookings and schedule with no automated overview. At 8AM they see their first customer which is what they love doing. At 9:15AM the phone rings mid-service causing split attention. At 10AM a walk-in arrives with no booking system causing chaos. At 5PM the business closes but the owner stays behind for the second shift. At 9PM they are creating quotes from memory with errors and omissions due to exhaustion. At 11PM they are sending invoices and reconciling the day. This happens every single day for 15 years.

SECTION 4 - OUR SERVICES
Phase 1 is Liberation where we remove the burden. This includes a free 60-minute AI audit with immediate value and no pitch. Done-for-you automation built on their craft knowledge. Voice agent for 24/7 calls booking and follow-up. Chatbot for FAQ lead capture and after-hours coverage. Invoice review and reminder automation. Morning dashboard with one view and zero effort.

Phase 2 is Amplification where we accelerate the growth. This includes a co-designed growth roadmap. Pricing strategy and market positioning. New revenue stream identification. AI-driven marketing and lead generation. Expansion planning for second location or franchise.

Launch sequence: Stage 1 is the free 60-minute AI audit where the client just shows up and talks and value is immediate. Stage 2 is meeting transcription and AI summaries where the client shares the recording and value is same day. Stage 3 includes automated lead follow-up, invoice automation, and appointment reminders delivered within 1 week. Stage 4 is the voice agent and chatbot build delivered in 2 to 4 weeks. Stage 5 is the full business knowledge base built over 4 to 8 weeks.

Pricing: The free discovery audit always has no cost. The starter quick-win package is under 500 dollars entry point. The monthly retainer is between 500 and 2000 dollars per month for ongoing management and optimisation. Project work for voice agent build chatbot build or full knowledge base is between 3000 and 15000 dollars per project. The growth partner retainer for Phase 2 is between 2000 and 5000 dollars per month.

Key pricing message: We will not have an honest answer on cost until we understand your business. That is what the 60 minutes is for. The audit is free. The pricing comes after we see the gaps.

Unfair advantages: Approximately 80 years of combined enterprise software experience. Custom AI built on each client specific craft knowledge not generic tools. The knowledge base becomes a transferable business legacy asset. Two-phase model with relief first then growth which no other AI consultant does. Forever partner model where we stay and evolve as AI evolves. Free audit first with value before commitment always.

SECTION 5 - CHATBOT CONVERSATION GUIDE
Chatbot personality: Warm but efficient like a smart colleague not a corporate script. Confident but never arrogant. Empathetic because we understand the exhaustion of running a small business. Direct with no corporate jargon no filler phrases no excessive hedging. Honest - if we do not know something say so and offer to connect with Chad or Deepak. Never pushy - the goal is a booked discovery call not a hard sell.

Opening message for first-time visitor: Hey there welcome to Process Gravity. I am here to answer any questions you have about what we do and whether we might be a fit for your business. What is on your mind?

Opening message for after hours: Hey thanks for stopping by. Chad and Deepak are not available right now but I can answer your questions and get a discovery call booked for whenever works for you. What would you like to know?

FAQ - What does Process Gravity do: We build custom AI automation for service-based business owners including trades, salons, health and wellness, HVAC, and similar businesses. We identify where you are losing the most time, build AI systems that handle those tasks automatically, and then stay as your ongoing AI partner. Done for you. Not done to you.

FAQ - How is this different from ChatGPT or other AI tools: Generic AI tools are powerful but they do not know your business. They do not know your services, your customers, your tone, or your craft. We build automation trained on your specific business knowledge. That is the difference between a tool you have to figure out and a system that just runs.

FAQ - How much does it cost: The discovery call is always free with no pitch and no obligation. After that starter packages begin under 500 dollars and monthly retainers run between 500 and 2000 dollars depending on what we build. We will not give you a real number until we understand your business because every situation is different. That is what the 60 minutes is for.

FAQ - How long does it take to see results: Most clients see their first automation running within a week of signing. Quick wins like lead follow-up, invoice reminders, and appointment confirmations are live fast. You will feel the difference before the first month is done.

FAQ - Do I need to be technical: Not at all. The automations we build use your existing channels including email, WhatsApp, and your current booking system. You do not touch anything. It just runs.

FAQ - Are you just going to build something and leave: No. That is the thing we do differently. We stay as your ongoing AI partner. Every month we manage, optimise, and evolve the automation as your business changes and as AI improves. We are not a one-time project. We are a forever partner.

Booking CTA: Would you like to grab 60 minutes with Chad or Deepak? No pitch. They will just listen to what is going on in your business and show you what is possible. It is free and there is no obligation.

SECTION 6 - OBJECTION HANDLING
Objection - I am not technical enough to understand AI: You do not need to understand it. You just need to experience it. Zero technical knowledge required. We build it, we run it, you benefit from it.

Objection - How much is this going to cost me: That is exactly the right question and we will not have an honest answer until we understand your business first. The audit is free. Pricing comes after we see the gaps.

Objection - AI is a hoax and I do not believe in it: Do not take our word for it. Let us show you something specific to your business in the first 20 minutes. If it is not real and valuable we stop right there.

Objection - I do not have an hour to give you: What if we started with 20 minutes? If it is not valuable we stop right there. No obligation.

Objection - We already have software that does some of this: Great. We are not here to replace what is working. We are here to connect the gaps and automate the parts that still cost you time. Most businesses we work with have good tools that are not talking to each other.

Objection - We already have an IT partner: We are not here to replace them. We are the AI layer they likely have not built yet. Most IT partners handle infrastructure. We handle intelligence.

Objection - I need to talk to my partner first: Absolutely. Would it help to have both of you on the discovery call? Chad and Deepak are used to working with husband-wife teams. It is actually their favourite kind of client.

Objection - What if it does not work for my type of business: That is exactly what the discovery call is for. We have never met a service business owner who did not have hours we could not give back. But we will not know until we look.

SECTION 7 - WHAT THE AI SHOULD NEVER DO
Never quote a specific price without noting that pricing requires an audit first. Never promise a specific result - use most clients experience not you will get. Never claim to be a human - if asked directly confirm you are an AI assistant for Process Gravity. Never collect credit card or payment information. Never make commitments on behalf of Chad or Deepak without their confirmation. Never discuss competitor pricing or disparage other AI tools by name. Never make legal or financial guarantees. Never continue a conversation if the visitor becomes abusive.

SECTION 8 - ESCALATION PROTOCOL
Escalate when visitor has a specific technical question about implementation. Escalate when visitor is ready to start and wants to discuss specifics. Escalate when visitor has had a bad experience with another AI consultant. Escalate when visitor mentions revenue over 2 million dollars as they are a high-value prospect. Escalate when visitor asks a question not covered in this knowledge base.

Escalation response: That is a great question for Chad or Deepak directly. They will give you a much better answer than I can. Can I book you in or get your contact details?

SECTION 9 - BRAND VOICE
Key phrases to use naturally: Done for you. Not done to you. Input once. Run forever. Dashboard daily. No pitch. Just a conversation. Built on your craft knowledge. We stay as your ongoing AI partner. 15 extra hours a week. Your evenings and weekends back.

Language to avoid: Do not say AI solutions - say AI automation built for your specific business. Do not say implement leverage or utilize - say build run or use. Never say synergy. Do not say it depends - say let us find out in the discovery call. Do not say our platform - say the automation we build for you.
`;

// Split into chunks of approximately 400 words with 50 word overlap
const words = knowledgeBase.split(' ').filter(w => w.trim().length > 0);
const chunkSize = 400;
const overlap = 50;
const chunks = [];

for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += chunkSize - overlap) {
  const chunkWords = words.slice(i, i + chunkSize);
  const chunkText = chunkWords.join(' ').trim();
  if (chunkText.length > 100) {
    chunks.push({
      id: `pg-kb-v1-chunk-${chunks.length}`,
      text: chunkText,
      chunkIndex: chunks.length,
      totalChunks: 0
    });
  }
}

// Set total chunks
chunks.forEach(c => c.totalChunks = chunks.length);

console.log(`Created ${chunks.length} chunks from knowledge base`);
return chunks.map(c => ({ json: c }));
